pdf_page_count takes the password of an encrypted PDF

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*

fun main() {
    val result = Xberg.pdfPageCount(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(java.nio.file.Paths.get("pdf/password_protected.pdf")), "")
    println(result)
}
```
